method: Actual PF2e Actor.applyDamage on a detached native actor. Actor updates were intercepted and applied only in memory; diagnostic chat creation was intercepted. No world actor creation or live combat mutation.
changes: Native negative-damage healing with spell origin and healing modifiers
Observer-scoped cast memory without secret save outcomes; temporary immunity and duplicate-control estimates
Public witnessed Strike strength estimates, uncertain Incapacitation probabilities and initiative-aware brief Blindness
Idempotent tactical policy scoring, including changed-plan rescoring
Actor reset clears own observation memory and other observers records for restored sources and targets
limitations: The historical combat was neither replayed nor retroactively healed.
Public attack evidence is a heuristic for relative strength; unknown levels and secret saves remain unavailable to planning.
Force Barrage split targeting and injury-based overkill optimization remain future work.
